weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X. (Calculates X based on number of allies within 2 spaces of unit: 0 allies grants +6; 1 ally grants +4; 2 allies grants +2; ≥3 allies grants +0.) If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of unit's Atk.
